name: branding-tiny-businessman-figure-standing-among-giant-chess-pieces
title: A tiny 3D businessman figure in glasses standing confidently among giant black chess pieces
whatItIs: A macro photo of a small painted 3D toy figure of a bespectacled man in a suit, hands on hips, standing on a chessboard surrounded by blurred oversized black chess pieces (king, knight, pawns) with a blurred person in the background.
whatItMeans: Playful and strategic; miniature scale against giant pieces visualises facing big competitive challenges with confidence.
techniques: Scale a tiny character against oversized familiar objects.
Blur the background pieces to keep focus on the figure.
Use a chessboard as a ready-made strategy metaphor.

vocabulary.definition: Placing a small subject against much larger objects for effect.
